post.title: Christmas markets by train with kids
post.hook: Three Christmas markets, two easy trains
post.hook_b: you, me & 3 Christmas markets by train?
post.dates: 7 days, any week Nov 26 to Dec 13, 2026

slides.big: Three Christmas markets, two easy trains
slides.sub: 7 days with kids · Vienna, Salzburg, Munich
slides.pip: Both trains are direct, and both take under three hours.

slides.label: Vienna · nights 1 and 2
pips: A 12 m carousel and a kids' rink in the park next door.
Schönbrunn's palace market lets kids skate free.

slides.label: Salzburg · nights 3 and 4
pips: Hellbrunn's Advent has a train and a petting zoo on weekends.
Start on a Thursday and Salzburg lands on the weekend.

slides.label: Munich · nights 5 and 6
slides.dates: Marienplatz · Nov 20 to Dec 24 · closed Nov 22
pips: Advent music from City Hall's balcony, Sun to Thu at 5:15.
St. Nicholas visits the Residenz village Dec 6 and 7 from 5.

slides.label: The route
slides.pip: Fly into Vienna, home from Munich: no backtracking.

slides.label: Kids will love
items: A kids' cinema and game tables in the last 2nd-class car (21 or 31)
Reindeer train, Ferris wheel and a kids' rink in Rathauspark
Free, in the Residenz Christmas village, Nov 16 to Dec 22
slides.pip: Check the timetable's detail view for the family zone.

items: Through Dec 12, works in Germany slow the direct Railjet to Munich by about 15 minutes.
Munich's free kids' workshop needs a sign-up, 10 days ahead.
Hellbrunn's trick fountains are closed until March 25.

wrong_caption: Through Dec 12, construction in Germany makes the direct Railjet Xpress to Munich about 15 minutes slower. Two extra ICE pairs run.

sources: Wiener Christkindlmarkt (Rathausplatz): Nov 13 to Dec 26, 2026, daily 10 AM-10 PM (Dec 24 to 6:30 PM)

Wiener Christkindlmarkt: kids' Christmas world in Rathauspark (12 m double-decker carousel, reindeer train, Ferris wheel, 110 m2 kids' rink, free double-blade skates sizes 21-25 and helmets with a ticket)

Vienna Tourist Board: Weihnachtsmarkt Schloss Schönbrunn, Nov 6, 2026 to Jan 6, 2027 (10 AM-9 PM to Dec 23; Dec 24 10 AM-4 PM; Dec 25 to Jan 6 10 AM-7 PM); 'Glice-Eislaufplatz (für Kinder kostenfrei)', carousel, Ferris wheel, kids' railway, craft workshop
Salzburg tourist board: by ÖBB (Vienna-Salzburg two Railjets an hour, Railjet Xpress 2 h 25 min; Munich-Salzburg from 1 h 40 min)
ÖBB: Railjet family zone in the last 2nd-class car (car 21 or 31) with a kids' cinema (Kinderkino) and game tables; the timetable detail view shows which trains offer it

ÖBB construction brochure: DB works June 14 to December 12, 2026; the Railjet Xpress Wien-Linz-Salzburg-München (every two hours, as in the regular timetable) takes about 15 min longer; 2 extra ICE pairs Wien-Salzburg-München
Salzburger Christkindlmarkt: Nov 19, 2026 to Jan 1, 2027 (Mon-Thu 10-8:30, Fri 10-9, Sat 9-9, Sun/holiday 9-8:30)
Hellbrunner Adventzauber: kids' Christmas world (train and petting zoo, weekends 11 AM-6 PM)
Hellbrunner Adventzauber: Nov 19 to Dec 24, 2026 (Tue-Fri 1-8 PM, Sat/Sun/holiday 10 AM-8 PM; closed Mondays except Dec 21)
Schloss Hellbrunn: trick fountains and palace exhibition in winter break until Mar 25, 2027

muenchen.de: Weihnachtsdorf im Kaiserhof der Residenz (Nov 16 to Dec 22, daily 11 AM-9 PM; free fairy-tale forest; Nikolaus Dec 6 and 7 from 5 PM)
